purpose: Define the primary target-specific outcome from public reference controls without reading a development-bank or prospective-bank training outcome.
denominator: all generated molecular attempts in the fixed evaluation sample
deduplication: canonical isomeric SMILES; a qualifying molecule is counted once
primary_outcome: number of unique qualifying molecules divided by the fixed number of generated attempts

docking_affinity.threshold: median finite Vina affinity among the public Q07820 reference actives

gates.posebusters: pass every boolean check in the MolGenBench docked-pose configuration

strain_energy.threshold: 75th percentile among finite Q07820 reference-active docked poses

clash_score.threshold: 75th percentile among finite Q07820 reference-active docked poses

interaction_score.threshold: median finite MolGenBench interaction score among Q07820 reference actives

metric_eligibility.pose_dependent_metrics: MolGenBench native eligibility, including fewer than 15 rotatable bonds
metric_eligibility.molecule_specific_scientific_failure: retained in the denominator and does not qualify
metric_eligibility.infrastructure_failure: invalidates the affected evaluation shard and is not converted to a scientific zero

supporting_outcomes: novel qualifying-hit rate at maximum Morgan-fingerprint Tanimoto similarity below 0.4 to the warm-start construction corpus
known-active molecule and scaffold recovery as an oracle audit
qualification_rule: Run the complete endpoint on an independently sampled starting-policy panel before freezing the matched evaluation size. The endpoint qualifies only with nonzero unique hits, complete infrastructure-valid scoring, and enough support to compare two training seeds without relying on one molecule.
basis: MolGenBench Version4 target, docking, pose, interaction, and chemical-filter metrics
the established molecular hit-ratio convention of docking better than the median known active with QED above 0.5 and SA below 5
target-relative reference distributions for pose strain, clash, and interaction gates
